item.coloph: zhes pa dam tshigs lnga bcu pa rdzogs so/ /'di ni grong khyer chen po dgra 'joms zhes bya ba bu kam yul gyi dge slong A nan+da pradz+nyA zhes bya ba dang / zha lu lo tsA ba dge slong d+harma pA la b+ha dras/ dpal dag pa 'byung ba'i yul gru grwa'i gzhis kha lhun grub gling du/ sa skyong chos kyi spyan ldan dpon chen kun dga' rin chen rgyal po pa'i bka' bzhin bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ slar yang byams pa gling du lo tsA ba ba ri d+harma kIrtis bsgyur ba'i yig snying zhig la gtugs te dag par bya'o/ sngar gyi 'gyur snying la/ dam tshig lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs kyis mdzad pa zhes snang
